latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Mockup Video Generator Free.

- Instantly turn your app screenshots and product images into professional mockup demo videos.
- Supports PNG, JPG, MP4, MOV uploads up to 200MB; auto-generates 1080p MP4 videos in 30–60 seconds.
- Automatic cloud rendering pipeline—no editing skills or expensive software required.
- Built-in workflow for file uploading, session management, balance checking, and exporting videos.
- Ideal for app developers, marketers, and product designers wanting quick, high-quality mockup videos.
